We shipped a platform update today.

Three changes matter most. Query responses now come back in under 200 ms because we moved aggregation into the database layer. Dashboards refresh live instead of on a five-minute poll. And every workspace now gets audit logs by default, something enterprise customers have asked for since March.

There is one rough edge: the new dashboards drop support for the legacy widget API. If you built custom widgets before 2025, check the migration notes first.

Demo bookings are open on the site.
